identity.operation: Read supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
identity.condition: A PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT and is read to IEND.
identity.capability: Reach a supported handler that calls png_decompress_chunk.

requirement: Reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.

assessment.necessity_reason: The entry calls png_read_end, and supported late zTXt or compressed iTXt can call png_decompress_chunk. Whether those handlers are built and whether the old harness reaches them are unresolved.

before.requirement: For a valid PNG containing supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, reach its decompression while reading to IEND.
before.reason: The before-side zTXt and iTXt handlers admit post-IDAT chunks and call the decompressor, subject to build options. The harness calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info; the resulting duplicate-call error may prevent its later png_read_end call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before-side zTXt handler sets PNG_AFTER_IDAT and continues processing the chunk.
The before-side zTXt handler validates compressed text and calls the primary png_decompress_chunk contract.
A repeated image initialization invokes png_app_error.

after.requirement: For the same valid PNG, reach supported post-IDAT compressed ancillary metadata decompression while reading to IEND.
after.reason: The after-side zTXt and iTXt handlers retain routes to the decompressor. The g0002 change shown is comment text; the unresolved build options and duplicate-initialization outcome prevent a definite harness assessment.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The zTXt handler permits processing after IDAT.
A valid compressed zTXt chunk calls png_decompress_chunk.
The duplicate-call error warns or aborts depending on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The build recipe fixes the configuration, but its displayed edits do not establish compressed-text support.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same old harness uses the same read sequence on both sides. The supplied g0002 code does not establish a changed route, and a common preexisting blocker remains possible but unproved.
missing_information: The effective compressed-text read options under the supplied build recipe.
The initial and subsequent state of PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN when png_start_read_image invokes png_app_error.
The complete before and after png_read_end control flow to post-IDAT zTXt and iTXt handlers.

necessity_evidence.reason: Post-IDAT compressed text belongs to the harness’s read-to-end operation, but the packet does not establish whether compressed-text support is enabled or whether the harness reaches png_read_end after its duplicate image initialization. The g0002 change shown does not itself change the decompression route.

scope_contract.reason: The harness reads PNG rows and calls png_read_end with an end-info structure. The source’s zTXt handler permits processing after IDAT and can call png_decompress_chunk when that handler is enabled.

evidence.dependency_reason: The zTXt handler continues processing after IDAT.
Accepted compressed zTXt data calls the changed decompressor.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite PNG containing post-IDAT zTXt is describable, but the effective build options and the outcome of the duplicate initialization are unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes configuration but does not display the resulting compressed-text read options.
The second initialization enters a duplicate-call error branch.
That error warns or aborts according to a flag whose initial state is not supplied.

observable_consequence.reason: The packet does not establish that the old harness fails to reach post-IDAT decompression. It calls png_read_end, but the end-reading body and duplicate-call outcome are missing.

evidence.dependency_reason: png_start_read_image treats an initialized row state as a duplicate call.
The duplicate-call consequence depends on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The harness’s png_read_end call may already provide the required route. Compressed iTXt is another possible route; post-IDAT iCCP is rejected and cannot serve as one. Their effective reachability is unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: The iTXt handler continues after IDAT.
Compressed iTXt can call the same decompressor.
The iCCP handler rejects a chunk after IDAT.

identity_preserved.reason: The before and after contracts concern the same post-IDAT compressed-text decompression tuple and the same old harness sequence. The shown g0002 difference is comment text, so timing cannot be inferred from that difference.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the before-side allocation and memset region.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before-side zTXt handler permits post-IDAT compressed text and calls png_decompress_chunk.
The after-side zTXt handler retains that route.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Fixes the build recipe used to assess enabled read options.

missing_information: Effective PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED and PNG_READ_iTXt_SUPPORTED settings under the supplied recipe.
Initial PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN state of the created read structure.
Complete before and after png_read_end bodies showing dispatch of post-IDAT compressed text.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Decompress supported zTXt or compressed iTXt metadata after IDAT while reading to IEND.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A build with the relevant compressed-text reader enabled, a valid PNG with such a chunk after IDAT, and a read sequence that reaches png_read_end.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old harness calls png_read_update_info, then png_start_read_image, reads rows, and calls png_read_end; effective options and duplicate-call outcome are unresolved.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Unestablished: post-IDAT compressed metadata would remain undecompressed if the duplicate call aborts before png_read_end.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: png_read_end may reach the metadata; compressed iTXt may also reach png_decompress_chunk. Post-IDAT iCCP is rejected.
